FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Major reworking
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Substantial rework to make roles def-definable.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: UI Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Various changes and updates to the various UI elements.

patchNoteLines.li: Various changes and updates to the UI elements to make relevant information more evident.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: UI & Role Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Consolidate the Defense and Commander specialists, and show the actual chances of specialist death on the specialist tab.

patchNoteLines.li: Folds the Defense Specialist mechanics into the Commander specialist
Add the death on defeat chances to the specialist tab

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: UI Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Update scrollbars to use ScrollUtil from the base mod.

patchNoteLines.li: Update scrollbars to use ScrollUtil from the base mod

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Commander Buff
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Buff the commander role to actually do a decent job of preventing death.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Assignment Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Blocks prisoners and slaves from being assigned as residents, specialists, or governors.

patchNoteLines.li: Add IsPriseron and IsSlave checks to the IsEligible check for specialist assignment validity

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Base Mod Upates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates some of the backend code to account for changes in Empire Refactored.

patchNoteLines.li: Account for changes to the base mod API

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Codex update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds Empire Codex entries to explain Specialists & Governors' mechanics.

patchNoteLines.li: Add Codex entries for the mod's mechanics

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Value Tuning
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Tunes some of the specialist bonuses, and also adds settings sliders to let the player change how specialist bonuses scale by skill level.

patchNoteLines.li: Tune governor, commander, and generalist bonuses
Add settings sliders to let the player change how bonuses scale with skill level

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fixes & Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Numerous fixes, updates, and a minor feature.

patchNoteLines.li: Governor upkeep scales based on their skills, now
The base Specialists limit was nerfed (5 -> 3)
Governors, Specialists, and Residents can now be easily sent directly by transport pod
Bugfix: pawns that were recalled from a settlement were incorrectly removed from the world pawn pool, resulting in them disappearing into the void on the next caravan tick

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor backend change to account for a base mod API update. No user-facing changes.
